replication.claim: Number embeddings are periodic with periods 2, 5, 10
replication.published: Fourier peaks at T = 2, 5, 10 in GPT-J (Kantamneni & Tegmark Fig. 2); 2, 2.5, 5, 10 (Zhou et al. 2024)
replication.criterion: at least two of {2, 5, 10} among the top-4 periods (±5%)

replication.claim: Numbers lie on a generalized helix (T = 2, 5, 10, 100)
replication.published: helix fits the residual stream of GPT-J / Pythia-6.9B / Llama-3.1-8B
replication.ours: pythia-2.8b layer 11: held-out R² 0.49 vs -0.09 for a shuffled helix, 0.24 linear-only
replication.criterion: held-out helix R² ≥ 0.5 and ≥ 0.2 above the shuffled control

replication.claim: Patching along the helix recovers most of the full-layer effect
replication.published: GPT-J: helix 7.21 vs full 8.34 logit diff (86%); PCA 6.13
replication.ours: pythia-2.8b layer 1: median recovery helix 77%, full layer 100%, PCA-9 81%, linear-only 5% (n = 80 correct prompts; accuracy 78%)
replication.criterion: helix ≥ 50% of the full-layer recovery and ≥ linear-only (needs ≥ 20 correctly solved prompts, else n/a)
